messages:
mariana: Stage pipeline is red on master after the kv cache merge. Multiple flakes in TestKVCacheEviction across runs. Anyone who can help bisect last-good?

ci-bot: Build failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345 (run-tests)

mariana: Key snippet from the failing log: ```
FAIL test_kv_cache.py::TestKVCacheEviction::test_evict_order - AssertionError: expected [a,b,c] but got [b,a,c]
Stack: /workspace/tests/test_kv_cache.py:87
Command: ./tools/run_tests --filter TestKVCacheEviction
```

jin: pinging @eng-infra — any clues? Did the recent deps bump touch eviction logic?

alex: I noticed flakes locally after merge of branch feature/kv-evict (commit 0a1b2c3). Last green on stage was c3f4e5d (yesterday).

mariana: adding that — can someone run a git bisect between c3f4e5d (good) and 0a1b2c3 (bad)? If it's flaky we might need repeated runs.

sre-oncall: I can run a bisect. If you can point to a deterministic test command that'll fail reproducibly, that helps. Suggested script: ```bash
# start bisect
git bisect start
git bisect bad 0a1b2c3
git bisect good c3f4e5d
# run stage tests only
./scripts/run-stage-tests.sh --filter TestKVCacheEviction || git bisect bad
# repeat to catch flakes
```

alex: I'll kick it off on an r4 worker now. Using --repeat=3 per step to reduce noise. Will update here.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345/retry

alex: bisect progress — narrowed to dep bump `kv-cache` between v1.14.0 -> v1.15.0. Early suspect: eviction comparator change (sort by last_access -> stable insert order changed).

mariana: if that's the culprit, we should revert the dep bump on release branch and open a patch to fix comparator. Can someone draft the revert PR?

jin: I'll open the revert PR against release/v1.2 and add a CI-only test that asserts eviction ordering semantics.

sre-oncall: once PR lands, we'll run a canary on staging and hold rollouts until passing for 24h.

mariana: thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround. If bisect finds anything else I'll post updates here. :raised_hands:
